WITH base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT *
    FROM stock_daily
    WHERE time >= '2025-01-01'
      AND time < '2026-01-01'
),

moves AS (
    SELECT
        stock_code,
        time,
        close,

        LAG(close) OVER (
            PARTITION BY stock_code
            ORDER BY time
        ) AS prev_close,

        (
            close
            - LAG(close) OVER (
                PARTITION BY stock_code

)

    time,
    close,
    prev_close,
    daily_return_pct
FROM moves
WHERE prev_close IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY daily_return_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

question_raw: Mức sinh lời từ phiên đầu năm đến phiên cuối năm của HSG trong năm 2025 là bao nhiêu?

    SELECT DISTINCT *
    FROM stock_daily
    WHERE time >= '2025-01-01'
      AND time < '2026-01-01'
),

ordered AS (
    SELECT
        stock_code,
        time,
        close,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY stock_code
            ORDER BY time ASC
        ) AS rn_asc,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY stock_code
            ORDER BY time DESC
        ) AS rn_desc

    FROM base
    WHERE stock_code = 'HSG'
)

SELECT
    a.stock_code,
    a.time AS first_time,
    a.close AS first_close,

    b.time AS last_time,

    / NULLIF(a.close, 0) AS return_pct

FROM ordered a
JOIN ordered b
    ON a.stock_code = b.stock_code

WHERE a.rn_asc = 1
  AND b.rn_desc = 1;

        quarter,
        data_sum AS interest_expense_q3

        AND quarter = 3
        AND category_code = 'IS_049'
),
Q2 AS (
    SELECT 
        industry,
        year,
        quarter,
        data_sum AS interest_expense_q2
    FROM 
        industry_financial_statement
    WHERE 
        industry = 'Food and Beverages'
        AND year = 2024
        AND quarter = 2
        AND category_code = 'IS_049'
)

    q3.industry,
    q3.year,
    q3.quarter,
    (q3.interest_expense_q3 - q2.interest_expense_q2) / q2.interest_expense_q2 AS interest_expense_growth
FROM 
    Q3 q3
JOIN 
    Q2 q2 ON q3.industry = q2.industry
LIMIT 10;
